nodes.name: Set Config
nodes.notes:
CONFIGURATION NODE - Edit these values to customize your invoice automation.

1. invoicingProvider: Choose 'quickbooks', 'stripe', or 'pdf_only'
2. crmProvider: Choose 'hubspot', 'airtable', or 'manual'
3. sheetId: Your Google Sheets ID (from the URL)
4. driveRootFolderId: Optional Google Drive folder for PDFs
5. ownerNotificationEmail: Your email for alerts
6. testMode: Set to true to send all emails to yourself first

nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes:
WEBHOOK TRIGGER

Send POST requests to this webhook URL with the invoice payload.

Required fields:
- client_name
- client_email
- billable_event_id
- items (array)
- total

Optional fields:
- client_company
- client_id
- invoice_number_optional
- subtotal, tax, discount
- notes, po_number
- service_period_start/end

nodes.name: Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key
Check Dedupe in Sheet
nodes.notes:
DEDUPE CHECK

Searches the Invoice Log sheet for an existing record with the same dedupe_key.

If found, we skip invoice creation to prevent duplicates.

Connect your Google Sheets credential here.

nodes.name: Is New Invoice?
nodes.notes:
DEDUPE DECISION

If no matching record found (length = 0), proceed with invoice creation.

Otherwise, skip to avoid duplicates.

nodes.name: Create QuickBooks Invoice
nodes.notes:
QUICKBOOKS INVOICE CREATION

To set up:
1. Create a QuickBooks OAuth2 credential in n8n
2. Replace YOUR_COMPANY_ID in the URL with your QBO company ID
3. Ensure your OAuth app has invoice write permissions

The invoice will be created with line items, due date, and customer email.

parameters.customer: ={{ $('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.client_id || $('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.client_email }}

additionalFields.description: ={{ $('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.items.map(i => i.description).join(', ') }}

nodes.name: Create Stripe Invoice
nodes.notes:
STRIPE INVOICE CREATION

To set up:
1. Create a Stripe credential in n8n with your API key
2. Ensure the customer exists in Stripe (by email or customer ID)
3. Add invoice items before or let Stripe auto-create

Note: You may need to add invoice items separately before creating the invoice.

assignments.name: result.manual_payment_note
assignments.value: Manual payment link needed - no automated payment provider configured

nodes.name: Generate PDF Invoice Data
nodes.notes:
PDF ONLY MODE

When no payment provider is configured, this creates invoice data for HTML/PDF generation.

The email will include the invoice details inline with instructions for manual payment.

nodes.name: Log Invoice to Sheet
nodes.notes:
INVOICE LOG

This logs all invoice data to your Google Sheet.

Ensure your sheet has these column headers:
timestamp_created, billable_event_id, dedupe_key, client_name, client_email, total, currency, invoice_number, provider, provider_invoice_id, invoice_url, due_date, status, amount_paid, balance_due, last_reminder_type, last_reminder_ts, reminder_count, drive_url, notes, error

assignments.name: email.to
assignments.value: ={{ $('Load Config').item.json.config.testMode ? $('Load Config').item.json.config.ownerNotificationEmail : $('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.client_email }}

assignments.name: email.subject
assignments.value: ={{ ($('Load Config').item.json.config.testMode ? '[TEST MODE] ' : '') + 'Invoice ' + $json.result.invoice_number + ' from ' + $('Load Config').item.json.config.companyName + ' due ' + $('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.due_date }}

assignments.name: email.body
assignments.value:
={{ ($('Load Config').item.json.config.testMode ? '
TEST MODE - This email would go to: ' + $('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.client_email + '
' : '') + `

Invoice from ${$('Load Config').item.json.config.companyName}

Dear ${$('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.client_name},

Please find your invoice details below:

Invoice Number ${$json.result.invoice_number}
Amount Due $${$('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.total.toFixed(2)} ${$('Load Config').item.json.config.currency}
Due Date ${$('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.due_date}
Description ${$('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.items.map(i => i.description).join(', ')}
${$json.result.invoice_url ? '

View and Pay Invoice

' : '

Payment Instructions: Please contact us at ' + $('Load Config').item.json.config.replyToEmail + ' for payment details.

'} ${$('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.notes ? '

Notes: ' + $('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.notes + '

' : ''}

If you have any questions about this invoice, please reply to this email or contact us at ${$('Load Config').item.json.config.replyToEmail}.

Thank you for your business!

${$('Load Config').item.json.config.companyName}
${$('Load Config').item.json.config.companyAddress}

` }}

nodes.name: Send Invoice Email (Gmail)
nodes.notes:
GMAIL SEND

Connect your Gmail OAuth credential here.

The email includes:
- Invoice number and amount
- Due date
- Payment link (if available)
- Service description
- Contact information

parameters.subject: ={{ '[ALERT] Invoice Error - ' + $('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.invoice_number }}
parameters.message:
={{ `

Invoice Creation/Send Error

An error occurred while processing an invoice:

  • Invoice Number: ${$('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.invoice_number}
  • Client: ${$('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.client_name} (${$('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.client_email})
  • Amount: $${$('Calculate Due Date and Dedupe Key').item.json.invoice.total}
  • Error: ${$json.error?.message || 'Email send failed'}

Recommended Action: Check the n8n workflow execution log and retry manually if needed.

` }}

nodes.name: Notify Owner of Error
nodes.notes:
ERROR NOTIFICATION

Sends an alert to the owner when invoice creation or email sending fails.

nodes.name: HubSpot Deal Stage Change
nodes.notes:
HUBSPOT CRM TRIGGER

This triggers when a deal stage changes.

To set up:
1. Connect your HubSpot credential
2. The workflow will trigger on deal stage changes
3. Filter for 'Closed Won' or your billing milestone stage

You may need to configure the specific stage ID in the filter node.

nodes.name: Is Closed Won?
nodes.notes:
STAGE FILTER

Edit the 'closedwon' value to match your HubSpot deal stage ID that should trigger invoicing.

Common stage IDs:
- closedwon (Closed Won)
- qualifiedtobuy (Qualified)
- Custom stage IDs can be found in HubSpot settings

assignments.name: invoice.items
assignments.value: ={{ [{ description: $json.properties?.dealname?.value || 'Services', quantity: 1, unit_price: Number($json.properties?.amount?.value || 0), amount: Number($json.properties?.amount?.value || 0) }] }}

nodes.name: Normalize HubSpot Data
nodes.notes:
HUBSPOT DATA MAPPING

This maps HubSpot deal properties to the invoice format.

Customize the mappings based on your HubSpot setup:
- dealname -> invoice description
- amount -> invoice total
- Associated contact email -> client_email
- Associated company -> client_company

nodes.name: Airtable Webhook
nodes.notes:
AIRTABLE CRM TRIGGER

To set up:
1. In Airtable, create an automation that triggers on record updates
2. Use 'When record matches conditions' with Status = 'Ready to Invoice'
3. Configure the automation to send a webhook to this n8n URL
4. Include the record fields in the webhook body

assignments.name: invoice.items
assignments.value: ={{ [{ description: $json.body?.fields?.['Description'] || $json.fields?.['Description'] || 'Services', quantity: 1, unit_price: Number($json.body?.fields?.['Amount'] || $json.fields?.['Amount'] || 0), amount: Number($json.body?.fields?.['Amount'] || $json.fields?.['Amount'] || 0) }] }}

nodes.name: Normalize Airtable Data
nodes.notes:
AIRTABLE DATA MAPPING

Customize field names to match your Airtable base:
- Client Name
- Client Email
- Company
- Amount
- Description
- Invoice Number
- PO Number
- Notes
